sources.title: The Terminator: Bill Paxton and Brian Thompson recall their Observatory scene

death.title: The Terminator
death.label: Deaths at Griffith Observatory
death.story_role: Two punks killed by the T-800 at Griffith Observatory

story_time.basis: Los Angeles, 1984, per American Cinematheque synopsis.

audit.basis: Paxton’s first-person account identifies his punk leader as killed; Thompson separately recalls his punk’s killing at the Observatory. The third punk, played by Brad Rearden, surrenders his clothes and has no confirmed on-screen death. Count two, not all three.
audit.identities: Descriptive character labels follow the released film. Actor names and uncertain novelization aliases are not treated as character names.
